bio.text: Steve Manos is the Republican candidate for California's 39th Congressional District in 2026.
According to his campaign website, he was elected to the Lake Elsinore City Council in 2012 and has served as mayor in 2015, 2019, 2024 and 2026.
The site says he grew up in the Inland Empire (listed as raised there since 1987), has owned a business since 1996, and is a past president of the Inland Valleys Association of Realtors.
It also lists directorships on the Southern California Association of Governments and the Riverside County Habitat Conservation Authority.
